column8: Additional formulas must be named: '~1' does not say which parameter it belongs to. Write it two-sided, as sigma ~ x, or name it, as sigma = ~ x
Invalid parameter name 'a.b': names must be alphanumeric and must not contain dots or underscores (they collide with coefficient naming)
Invalid parameter name 'a_b': names must be alphanumeric and must not contain dots or underscores (they collide with coefficient naming)
Additional formulas must be named: '~1' does not say which parameter it belongs to. Write it two-sided, as sigma ~ x, or name it, as sigma = ~ x
Nested formulas are not allowed: the right-hand side of 'y ~ ~x' is itself a formula. Did you use '~~' somewhere?
Can only equate parameters of the same class. 'sigma1' is of class 'sigma' and 'sigmaa2' of class 'sigmaa'
Equating parameters of class 'mu' is not allowed.
Equating 'sigma1' with itself is not meaningful.
Cannot use predicted parameters on the right-hand side of an equation. 'shape1' has a formula of its own, so equate the other way round
Cannot use fixed parameters on the right-hand side of an equation. 'shape1' is itself fixed or equated
